[TPS_SWCT_1219] ComSpec for queued and non-queued sender-receiver com- munication⌈ Sender-receiver communication might be queued or non-queued. This aspect is reﬂected in the speciﬁcation of the applicable ComSpec meta-classes. While the case of queued communication the queueLength attribute remains the only infor- mation item the non-queued case foresees several attributes for controlling communi- cation behavior.⌋ 119 of 566 — AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL — Document ID 062: AUTOSAR_TPS_SoftwareComponentTemplate
